title: National Palace Museum
scope: The existing five-pavilion main building of Taipei’s National Palace Museum and its attached upper visitor terrace, stairs and sloped skylight at Waishuangxi.
limitations: The five pavilion forms, white lower walls and central roof proportions follow the cleared original photographs. Exact dimensions, ornament, rear elevations, the terraced right extension and glazed bays are approximate.
The main gallery building and its immediate upper terrace are in scope. The lower campus gate and neighboring museum buildings are separate structures.
